title: How often do you do it?

sections.title: Frequency and hobbies
sections.content: The five frequency words from earlier work with hobby verbs just as with any other verb. They stand right before the verb: *Gyakran úszom.* (I often swim.) *Ritkán futok.* (I rarely run.) *Soha nem teniszezem.* (I never play tennis.) *Hetente* means every week. To ask, use *Milyen gyakran?* (How often?). *Teniszezik* is an *-ik* verb, so it is *teniszezem*, not *teniszezek*.
*Hetente* is a word of its own and needs no ending. Keep the *-m* of the *-ik* verbs: *úszom*, *teniszezem*, *focizom*.
